question: Which diverse classes of beings are included among those mentioned in this teaching?
premises: Semi-divine and anti-divine beings are listed
Ascetics rich in austerity are included
inference: Therefore, gandharvas, kinnaras, yakshas, asuras, and ascetics are all included.
uncertainties: garndhavāḥ appears to be a nonstandard spelling of gandharvāḥ
plain_english: Gandharvas, kinnaras, yakshas, asuras, and ascetics.
